title: AuxiliaryMigrationLedger
description: config/auxiliary-migrations.yaml. One-time SQL statements for destructive changes to unversioned objects. Each entry runs at most once, tracked by gkg_auxiliary_migrations.

id.description: Sequential identifier. Must be unique and never reused.

sql.description: Idempotent SQL statement (must use IF EXISTS / IF NOT EXISTS). May be executed more than once under concurrent boot or crash recovery.
